name: Pond0x PNDX public directTransfer
summary: The Pond0x (PNDX) token 0x1d4214081985ad20aa3ca93a2206ae792635cbec kept solady's mock helpers directTransfer(from, to, amount) and directSpendAllowance as public functions with no access control. directTransfer calls _transfer(from, to, amount) for any from, so anyone could move anyone's PNDX. About four hours after launch, 1,431 accounts made 7,778 such transfers out of 2,248 other holders and sold the tokens into the Uniswap PNDX/WETH pools. Those accounts' transactions took a net 81.029522709579604392 WETH out of the pools.
notes: directTransfer is public in the deployed runtime and depends on no configured state; the token has no proxy or code-selecting storage.

Stolen PNDX has no reliable USD mark: all PNDX/WETH pools together held at most about 18.6 WETH, so the reported 2.2M USD (SlowMist) is notional token value. The record measures the value the takers realised instead. Takers are the 1,431 EOAs with at least one successful direct directTransfer (0xf83d1791) whose from differs from msg.sender (7,778 calls, blocks 17792696-25611089, from the token's complete Etherscan txlist). Pools are Uniswap V2 0xa02b1596c48ec451482414e59c3c9895e06a2cc3 and V3 0xab19731eba97938c12f6fd7cf395fd6a414b556d (0.05%), 0x2ab3af4e9e69c29efc5b89be55e43077a07525e9 (0.3%) and 0x702747ac260e54b5511c311610c5e55951e47406 (1%). Over blocks 17792696-17900000, summing WETH Transfer logs into and out of the pools in the 1,202 transactions sent by takers gives net -81.029522709579604392 WETH (gross outflows -98.763772269177). The same pools gained +82.393523181233881890 WETH from other senders. This net figure is a lower bound on value taken: it nets the takers' own buys and misses thefts routed through contracts. Valued at the anchor-time DefiLlama WETH price.
Loss is a lower bound: the realised net WETH of identified direct takers, not the notional value of stolen PNDX; contract-mediated thefts and takers' gross proceeds are not counted.
